snippet.title: Combo Critters: Battle Checkers // Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513440/Combo_Critters_Battle_Checkers/

A strategic, combo-driven twist on checkers! Battle quirky ninjas and their overlord bosses, unleash combos, and dominate the board. A completely fresh take on Checkers in a turn-based strategy game. Coming soon to Steam!

Developed by
Twitchy Finger Limited
